archetype: quantitative grid and separate matched-actor trajectory panels
conclusion: Measure whether a neutral-initialized directed relation bias improves frozen Stage3B predictions overall and in preregistered spatial interaction contexts; the outcome is unknown before evaluation.

evidence_chain.training: Actual full official VAL150 points every500 optimizer updates, no smoothing, phase boundary and both selected best steps.
evidence_chain.main_ablation: Identically defined paired full-horizon Overall/Vehicle/Pedestrian/Bicycle minFDE6, exact value labels.
evidence_chain.interaction_context: All, Heterogeneous-20m, VP-context-20m, Vehicle >5m and Pedestrian >5m under fixed source/target geometry membership.
evidence_chain.relation_bias: Nine target-by-source entries of layer/head aggregated mean absolute bias; model diagnostic only, no causal interpretation.
evidence_chain.cases: Same real actor/window/GT and same axes in both panels; largest gains/degradation illustrate behavior and are not population-effect estimates.

statistics.n_definition: Correlated actor-windows; formal inference resamples paired scene clusters.
statistics.metric: minFDE@6; minADE@6 uses the best-FDE mode; MR endpoint>2m; Top1 uses maximum mode probability.
statistics.interval: Paired150-scene cluster percentile bootstrap,1000 replicates seed2022; bars show exact means without artificial error bars.

trajectory_case_policy.vehicle_improvement: Vehicle, GT>5m prioritized, Heterogeneous-20m true, negative Stage4A-minus-Stage3B FDE; largest gain with deterministic identity tie-break.
trajectory_case_policy.pedestrian_improvement: Pedestrian, GT>5m prioritized, Heterogeneous-20m true, negative Stage4A-minus-Stage3B FDE; largest gain with deterministic identity tie-break.
trajectory_case_policy.degradation: Positive FDE delta; GT>5m prioritized; largest degradation with deterministic identity tie-break.
trajectory_case_policy.VP_context: Distinct real V/P actor with nearest opposite-type actor<=20m at t0; GT future and predictions never define spatial context eligibility.
trajectory_case_policy.neighbors: Only nearest eligible heterogeneous context actor history and observed GT, faint thin lines; no neighbor prediction modes.
trajectory_case_policy.neighbor_caption: t0 spatial interaction context; no causal interaction inferred.
trajectory_case_policy.pairing: Same actor/window/GT/axes/equal aspect; reproduce each model's original full VAL16 batch.
trajectory_case_policy.inset: Only GT turn>30deg or hard trajectory overlap; bounding box from actual last6 target future points, never hardcoded.
trajectory_case_policy.map: Local lane segments faint grey alpha0.22 linewidth0.5; lanes never determine axes limits.
trajectory_case_policy.layout: Separate header for endpoint numbers and any inset; identical compact limits in both panels.

review_risks: Attention bias is not causal influence
No reuse of training VAL best numbers as fresh final evaluation
All12 markers and unclipped source text
